sourceTitle: The Greatest Thing In the World and Other Addresses
description: "The Greatest Thing In the World and Other Addresses" by Henry Drummond is a collection of spiritual addresses likely written in the late 19th century. The central theme revolves around the nature and significance of love, presented as the supreme essence of Christianity and human existence.
